home.hero.title: Describe your trip. Watch it land on the map.
home.hero.sub: Where, how many days, what pace? Settle it in a few taps and MapsBridge lays your route out day by day on the map and keeps it with you on the road.
home.hero.inputLabel: Where do you want to go?
home.hero.inputPlaceholder: e.g. 3 days in Rome, on foot, food-focused
home.hero.chips.label: Starting ideas
home.hero.trust.credits: Credits are only used for AI actions
home.hero.trust.welcome: 5 welcome credits with a free account

home.lastTrip.title: Your last trip
home.how.title: A draft route in three turns. Then refine it on the route.
home.how.step1.title: Describe.
home.how.step1.body: Write the city and the trip you have in mind in your own words. No forms.
home.how.step2.title: Answer two questions.
home.how.step2.body: At most two questions per turn, each with options you can tap: dates, pace, interests.
home.how.step3.title: Your route, on the map.
home.how.step3.body: By the third turn your day-by-day draft is on the map. From there we refine it on the route itself.
home.features.title: Plan it, share it, take it with you.
home.features.planner.title: Day-by-day planner.
home.features.planner.body: Add stops to days, drag to reorder, see each day's time and distance.
home.features.optimize.title: Route optimisation.
home.features.optimize.body: Reorder your stops over the real road network in one tap.
home.features.assistant.title: AI travel assistant.
home.features.assistant.body: Build and edit your route by chatting. Place details come from data, never made up.
home.features.share.title: Secure location sharing.
home.features.share.body: Time-limited, consent-based share links and codes.
home.features.messages.title: Messaging.
home.features.messages.body: Real-time chat with your travel companions.
home.features.community.title: Community.
home.features.community.body: Discover routes and guides shared by travellers.
home.independence.title: We don't sell tickets. We're with you.
home.independence.sub: MapsBridge isn't a booking engine. We own no inventory, and no one can buy a place in our suggestions.
home.independence.p1.title: No commission-based ranking.
home.independence.p1.body: Suggestions are ordered only by your interests, quality and fit with the route.
home.independence.p2.title: Prep lives in its own tab.
home.independence.p2.body: Links for stays or transport sit in a separate Prep tab, never inside route suggestions.
home.independence.p3.title: No made-up places.
home.independence.p3.body: Addresses, hours and coordinates come from sources; the assistant only understands your intent and explains.
home.credits.title: Credits are only used when the AI works.
home.credits.sub: Credits are reserved before an action starts and refunded automatically if it fails. Adding, reordering and sharing stops on the map costs nothing.
home.share.title: Did someone send you a location or a route?
home.share.sub: Enter the share code; if it's still valid and approved, it opens on the map. No account needed to view.
home.share.label: Share code
home.share.error: A code is 4–64 letters, digits or hyphens
home.mobile.title: Your route, on your phone too.
home.mobile.sub: The same planner, assistant and account on iOS and Android.
home.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
home.faq.q1: Can I try it without an account?
home.faq.a1: Yes. Describe your trip, answer the first questions and add stops on the map; your draft stays on your device. You need a free account for the AI to build your route.
home.faq.a2: Only on our servers, reserved just before a paid AI action starts and refunded automatically if it fails. Clarifying your preferences is free.
home.faq.a3: No. Nothing is ranked by commission; prep links sit in a separate tab and never affect the order of suggestions.
home.faq.a4: Your saved route's stops, coordinates and basic directions are stored on your device.
home.faq.a5: Turkish and English. We detect yours automatically and you can switch any time.
home.final.title: Let your next trip start with one sentence.

pricing.independence.title: Your plan never changes the ranking
pricing.independence.body: Our suggestions are never ranked by commission; a paid plan only gives you more AI credits.
pricing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
pricing.faq.a1: They are reserved on the server before a paid AI action starts. Adding, reordering and sharing stops on the map uses no credits.
pricing.faq.q2: What happens to my credits if an action fails?
pricing.faq.a2: The reserved credits are refunded automatically. Your balance always comes from the server.
pricing.faq.q3: What if I cancel my subscription?
pricing.faq.a3: You can cancel from the app store or your Stripe account; details are shown at the payment step.
pricing.faq.q4: Is a plan bought on the web valid on mobile?
pricing.faq.a4: Your credit balance belongs to your account. On the web you pay with Stripe, on mobile through the app store (RevenueCat).
